gold: Plasmablastic lymphoma (PBL), stage 1 with high-risk features

selector.why: The presence of CD138-positive and EBV-positive findings, along with fluorescence in situ hybridization showing gains of florescence signal at multiple loci, decided it, despite the CD20-negative and PAX5-negative findings that argue against it, as Plasmablastic Lymphoma can sometimes be CD20-negative.
